turns.text: Hello. How long does delivery take to another EU country, and do you take cash on delivery?
Hello! Delivery to other EU countries takes 5–8 working days. We accept card payments only and don’t offer cash on delivery.

rule.ro: Livrarea durează 1–2 zile lucrătoare în România și 5–8 zile lucrătoare în celelalte țări din Uniunea Europeană.
rule.en: Delivery takes 1 to 2 working days in Romania and 5 to 8 working days in other EU countries.

rule.ro: Plata se face doar cu cardul. Magazinul nu oferă plata ramburs.
rule.en: Payment is by card only. The shop does not offer cash on delivery.

turns.text: I am not asking about one order. I only need the shop rules on delivery time and payment.
No order details are needed. Delivery takes 1 to 2 working days in Romania and 5 to 8 working days in other EU countries. Payment is by card only. We don’t offer cash on delivery.
Germany would be the country, if that changes the answer. I do not want a reservation.
Germany is covered by our EU delivery rule: delivery takes 5–8 working days. Payment is by card only; cash on delivery isn’t available. No reservation has been made.
